$comment: The words of the section 'How our figures compare' on the Differences page: this site's figures set beside the figures other organisations publish, as the build's reconciliation file holds them. Read by src/lib/comparison.ts. Every text below is a template the lint holds to config/narrative/rules.json (kind 'comparison'): no digit, no causal or judgement word, no value or label of a reference file, and a name, a figure or a date comes in as a placeholder. A template says what the figures show and never why (CLAUDE.md invariant 8). The text of a measure, a definition and a known difference is the organisation's or the reference file's own and comes in as a placeholder or as it stands. public_kinds is the list of kinds of figure shown on the public page (a row's figure_kind); every other kind is counted in the closing sentence and listed on the internal status page. A sentence that cannot be filled is left out, not softened.
heading: How our figures compare

opening.many: {count} organisations publish figures that this site's can be set beside. The figures below are for {span}. This site's figures are as at the snapshot of {date|date}.
opening.one: One organisation publishes figures that this site's can be set beside. The figures below are for {span}. This site's figures are as at the snapshot of {date|date}.

gap_note: A gap is this site's figure less theirs. A plus sign means this site's figure is higher and a minus sign means it is lower. The gap as a share is taken of their figure.

ours.all: This site's figure: {dataset}, with no conditions.

columns.gap_pct: Gap as a share of theirs

not_compared.month_not_held: This site does not hold this month yet, so the two figures are not set side by side.
not_compared.dataset_not_built: This site does not hold this count yet, so the two figures are not set side by side.
not_compared.hidden_cell: This site hides figures that rest on a small count, and this is one, so the two are not set side by side.
not_compared.no_published_table: This site publishes no table of this count, so the two figures are not set side by side.
not_compared.value_not_held: This site does not hold a figure for this one in this build, so the two are not set side by side.
not_compared.other: The two figures are not set side by side in this build.

closing.many: {count} further figures are checked the same way in every build. They are not shown here.
closing.one: One further figure is checked the same way in every build. It is not shown here.

restated.heading: Figures a source has restated
restated.intro: {count} of the figures below were published earlier by their source, which now publishes another figure for the same month and measure, by the size the build warns about or more. Each is shown with the figure it published before and the one it publishes now. The build warns about each one. On those of these rows that the single-figure limit covers, it stops the build when this site's figure is that limit or more from both of the source's figures, and not when it is within the limit of either. A row the limit does not cover cannot stop a build alone, restated or not. The limit that takes more than one source counts each row against its current figure, as it does any row.
restated.caption: Figures a source has restated, newest month first

absent: The comparison with figures that organisations beyond this site publish is not in this build of the site yet. It arrives with the next monthly refresh.
empty: No published figures have been set beside this site's in this build.
